title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
shortDescription: Level-5's grand cel-shaded 3D evolution of Yuji Horii and Akira Toriyama's classic JRPG franchise.
historicalSignificance: First mainline Dragon Quest with full 3D traversal and orchestral soundtrack, earning international acclaim.
